You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
innalillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun allah ya kawo mana karshen tashe tashen hankulan nan allah ya ji kan su ya sa mutuwa ta zamo hutu a gare su amn

output.original_text: innalillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun allah ya kawo mana karshen tashe tashen hankulan nan allah ya ji kan su ya sa mutuwa ta zamo hutu a gare su amn
output.joy: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun! Allah ya kawo mana karshen tashe-tashen hankulan nan, ya jikan su da rahama, domin mu yi ta godiya ga ranar hutu a gare su!
output.sadness: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun... Allah ya kawo mana karshen tashe-tashen hankulan nan, ya jikan su daga wannan halin wahalar, mu bamu samun hutu a gare su.
output.fear: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun! Allah ya kawo mana karshen tashe-tashen hankulan nan, amma ina jin tsoron abinda zai faru idan ba mu zauna lafiya ba?
output.anger: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun! Allah ya kawo mana karshen wadannan tashe-tashen hankulan marasa ma'ana, ya jikan su daga wannan tashin hankali!
output.surprise: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun! Allah ya kawo mana karshen tashe-tashen hankulan nan, ha, ya yi kyau, mun shigo da wannan hutu ga su!
output.disgust: Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihirrajiun! Allah ya kawo mana karshen wadannan tashe-tashen hankulan nan, kyawawa! Wannan abu ya riga ya gaji!
